title.zh: Claude Code开始让AI审查AI：90%代码由Claude编写，低风险修改无需人工批准
title.en: Claude Code开始让AI审查AI：90%代码由Claude编写，低风险修改无需人工批准

current_state.zh: Anthropic disclosed that roughly 90% of Claude Code's code is now written by Claude and that it has rebuilt code review around multi-agent AI checking with risk-tiered human approval, while capping runaway review loops after one change went through 50+ rounds in a single night.
